description: The price of one software tool from the productgrowth.in directory: cheapest listed paid price in ₹ and how we got it (vendor lists rupees, or converted from dollars at the stated rate), whether it has a free plan, the date the price was checked, the vendor's pricing page, India fit, its score and recent price or plan changes. Read-only. Uses one call of your free Data API allowance.
